summary: Focused retest of 3 issues from iteration_35.json — all three fixes hold. (3) SessionCompletePage copy at L401 verified via source grep = 'Your 3-phase journey'.

Verified navigation trail: /interview/start -> /simulation/start -> /quiz/start -> /notes. The chained phase-gate redirects work as designed for a fresh session.
